system_overview:
{
  "core_purpose": "Build a simple game where users can enter English words and discover the total number of words that can be formed by rearranging the letters of the word, with the option to guess and type all the isomeric words.",
  "target_personas": [
    {
      "name": "Word Enthusiast",
      "context": "When using the app to play and learn about word anagrams and isomeric words",
      "motivation": "To explore and understand the relationships between words and their anagrams",
      "pain_point": "Frustration when trying to find all possible anagrams for a word"
    },
    {
      "name": "Casual Gamer",
      "context": "When using the app to play and compete with friends",
      "motivation": "To have fun and challenge themselves with word anagrams and isomeric words",
      "pain_point": "Disappointment when unable to find all possible anagrams for a word"
    },
    {
      "name": "Language Learner",
      "context": "When using the app to learn and practice vocabulary",
      "motivation": "To improve their language skills and knowledge of word relationships",
      "pain_point": "Difficulty when trying to find and remember new words and their anagrams"
    }
  ],
  "behavioral_dynamics": [
    "Users enjoy exploring and discovering new words and their relationships",
    "Users are motivated by competition and challenge",
    "Users learn best through interactive and engaging experiences",
    "Users become frustrated when unable to find all possible anagrams"
  ],
  "core_use_cases": [
    "Enter a word and receive a list of possible anagrams",
    "Attempt to find and list all possible isomeric words for a given word",
    "Complete all possible anagrams for a word to progress to the next word"
  ],
  "logical_workflows": [
    "Enter word -> Display count of possible anagrams -> User goes to a page where they can try to guess and type all possible isomeric words",
    "> User receives feedback on correct and incorrect words",
    "Complete all possible anagrams -> User progresses to the next word",
    "User becomes frustrated or disengaged -> App offers to shelve the session to go and type a new word similar to the start page."
  ],
  "human_edge_cases": [
    "User enters a word with repeated letters or special characters",
    "User is unable to find all possible anagrams for a word due to limited knowledge or skills",
    "User becomes frustrated or disengaged when unable to find all possible anagrams",
    "User experiences technical issues or app crashes",
    "User forgets their progress or needs to resume later"
  ],
  "success_indicators": [
    "User completes all possible anagrams for a word",
    "User finds and lists all possible isomeric words for a given word",
    "User progresses to the next word with a sense of accomplishment and engagement",
    "User feels motivated and encouraged to continue playing and learning"
  ]
}
